_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "depth" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "image_sha" TEXT NULL, "product_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_visible" IN (0, 1)), "deletion_mark" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deletion_mark" IN (0, 1)), "server_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "base_unit_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_precision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("qty_precision" BETWEEN 0 AND 3), "has_variants" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_variants" IN (0, 1)), "is_sellable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_sellable" IN (0, 1)), "multiplicity_milli" INTEGER NULL, "min_qty_milli" INTEGER NULL, "primary_image_sha" TEXT NULL, "attributes_json" TEXT NULL, "deletion_mark" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deletion_mark" IN (0, 1)), "server_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "default_variant_id" TEXT NULL, "base_unit_id" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "sku_norm" TEXT NULL, "attributes_json" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "image_sha" TEXT NULL, "deletion_mark" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deletion_mark" IN (0, 1)), "server_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "multiplicity_milli" INTEGER NULL, "unit_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "units" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_precision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("qty_precision" BETWEEN 0 AND 3), "id" TEXT NULL, "short_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "packagings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "factor_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("factor_milli" > 0), "allow_fraction" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_fraction" IN (0, 1)), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "variant_id" TEXT NULL, "unit_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "barcodes" ("value" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NULL, "packaging_id" TEXT NULL, "barcode_type" TEXT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("value"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "warehouses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_name" TEXT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("visible" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prices" ("variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_list_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "packaging_id" TEXT NULL, "price_tyiyn" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("variant_id", "price_list_id", "packaging_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_balances" ("variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "warehouse_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NULL, "reserved_milli" INTEGER NULL, "available_milli" INTEGER NULL, "stock_level" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK("stock_level" IN ('in_stock', 'low', 'out', 'unknown')), "snapshot_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("variant_id", "warehouse_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_images_meta" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NULL, "sha" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), "sizes_json" TEXT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("sha", "product_id", "variant_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites_products" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pending_op" TEXT NULL CHECK("pending_op" IN ('add', 'remove')), PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites_customers" ("customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pending_op" TEXT NULL CHECK("pending_op" IN ('add', 'remove')), PRIMARY KEY ("customer_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cart_draft" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'parked', 'converted', 'cleared')), "name" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "warehouse_id" TEXT NULL, "price_list_id" TEXT NULL, "discount_percent_hundredths" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("discount_percent_hundredths" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "base_row_version" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cart_items_draft" ("local_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_cart_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_item_id" TEXT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "packaging_id" TEXT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity_milli" >= 0), "price_snapshot_tyiyn" INTEGER NULL, "stock_snapshot_milli" INTEGER NULL, "price_changed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("price_changed" IN (0, 1)), "stock_insufficient" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("stock_insufficient" IN (0, 1)), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK("sync_state" IN ('synced', 'pending', 'dead')), PRIMARY KEY ("local_item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox_actions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('cart.sync', 'favorite.add', 'favorite.remove', 'recent.touch', 'recent.clear', 'notification.read', 'auth.logout', 'profile.settings')), "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK("status" IN ('pending', 'sending', 'done', 'failed', 'dead')), "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recent_products" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_viewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "view_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notifications_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("scope" IN ('user', 'device')), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "registration_draft" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "checkout_draft" ("local_cart_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("step" IN ('customer', 'delivery', 'payment', 'review')), "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "delivery_method" TEXT NULL CHECK("delivery_method" IN ('pickup', 'delivery')), "receiver_kind" TEXT NULL CHECK("receiver_kind" IN ('customer', 'other_person')), "payment_method" TEXT NULL CHECK("payment_method" IN ('cash', 'qr_bakai', 'credit')), "order_idempotency_key" TEXT NULL, "submitted_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_cart_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_meta" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("entity" IN ('categories', 'products', 'variants', 'units', 'packagings', 'barcodes', 'warehouses', 'price_lists', 'prices', 'stock', 'images', 'favorites', 'notifications')), "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_cursor" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "as_of" INTEGER NULL, "stale_after_sec" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX categories_parent_idx ON categories (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX categories_path_idx ON categories (path)
CREATE INDEX products_category_idx ON products (category_id)
CREATE INDEX products_sku_norm_idx ON products (sku_norm)
CREATE INDEX products_name_norm_idx ON products (name_norm)
CREATE INDEX product_variants_product_idx ON product_variants (product_id)
CREATE INDEX product_variants_sku_norm_idx ON product_variants (sku_norm)
CREATE INDEX packagings_product_idx ON packagings (product_id)
CREATE INDEX packagings_variant_idx ON packagings (variant_id)
CREATE INDEX barcodes_variant_idx ON barcodes (variant_id)
CREATE INDEX barcodes_server_id_idx ON barcodes (server_id)
CREATE INDEX prices_list_variant_idx ON prices (price_list_id, variant_id)
CREATE INDEX prices_server_id_idx ON prices (server_id)
CREATE INDEX stock_balances_warehouse_available_idx ON stock_balances (warehouse_id, available_milli)
CREATE INDEX product_images_meta_product_idx ON product_images_meta (product_id)
CREATE INDEX product_images_meta_server_id_idx ON product_images_meta (server_id)
CREATE INDEX cart_draft_status_idx ON cart_draft (status)
CREATE INDEX cart_items_draft_cart_idx ON cart_items_draft (local_cart_id)
CREATE INDEX outbox_actions_owner_status_next_idx ON outbox_actions (owner_user_id, status, next_attempt_at)
CREATE INDEX recent_products_viewed_idx ON recent_products (last_viewed_at)
CREATE INDEX notifications_cache_read_idx ON notifications_cache (read_at)
